📖 How to use

  1. Enter the wedding date.
  2. Optionally add the ceremony time.
  3. Watch the live countdown tick in days, hours, minutes and seconds.
  4. Share the tab on a screen at the engagement party.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does the countdown update live?

Yes — it ticks every second while the page is open, showing days, hours, minutes and seconds remaining.

Can I include the ceremony time?

Yes, add the time of day for a precise countdown; otherwise it counts down to midnight at the start of the date.

What if the wedding already happened?

The tool switches to celebration mode and shows how long you have been married instead.
